tagline: Gentle little stories for peaceful bedtimes.
style: Delicate watercolor children's picture-book illustration with soft pastel colors, rounded shapes, clean outlines, glowing warm light, and rich cozy details.
world: A sun-dappled woodland valley where miniature cottage gardens, mossy hollows, and lantern-lit burrows welcome gentle, curious friends every day.

characters.name: Barnaby
characters.look: A small, plump honey-brown dormouse wearing knitted mustard dungarees, featuring large round velvety ears, friendly dark eyes, and tiny soft teal booties.
characters.personality: Thoughtful, unhurried, and observant, Barnaby loves collecting smooth river pebbles and noticing the tiny wonders others miss.

characters.name: Milly
characters.look: A four-year-old girl with rosy cheeks, soft curly black pigtails, wearing a pale mint-green pinafore dress over a cream long-sleeved shirt.
characters.personality: Warmhearted, imaginative, and endlessly gentle, Milly delights in sharing stories and humming calming lullabies to woodland insects.

characters.name: Pipkin
characters.look: A small, slow-moving sage-green tortoise with warm crinkled eyes, wearing a hand-knit burgundy wool scarf and tiny round brass spectacles.
characters.personality: Patient, deeply reassuring, and wise, Pipkin acts as a quiet guide who helps untangle small worries with warm herbal tea.
